parameters.name: FolderIdentifier
parameters.description: UUID of folder to audit; optional unless FileId absent.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description: Owner entity type; required when FolderIdentifier is provided.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Results per page; maximum allowed value is 100.

400.description: Bad Request — neither FileId nor FolderId provided, entityType absent when FolderIdentifier present, or pageSize exceeds 100.

403.description: Forbidden — insufficient scope or tenant access denied.

404.description: Not Found — file or folder does not exist or belongs to another tenant.

Downloads the binary content of a file attached to an entity as octet-stream.
Provide the entityId and fileId returned from the upload response Location header.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Entity integer ID owning the file.

parameters.name: FileId
parameters.description: UUID of the file to download.

patch.summary:
Moves a file to another folder or archives it via JSON Patch RFC 6902.
Only replace ops on /folderId (positive int) or /status (value: archive) are accepted.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: UUID of file to patch; route parameter

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional UUID v4; deduplicates retries 24 hours

requestBody.description:
The JSON Patch operations (RFC 6902) to apply. Supported:
[{ "op": "replace", "path": "/folderId", "value": "<folderId>" }] -- moves the file.
[{ "op": "replace", "path": "/status", "value": "archive" }] -- archives the file.

400.description: Bad Request - unsupported or malformed patch document.

404.description: Not Found - file does not exist or feature is disabled.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - operation cannot be applied to the current file state.

delete.summary:
Soft-deletes a file by moving it to the recycle bin. File is hidden from standard queries but recoverable
by administrators. Requires write scope and EnableFileManagement feature flag active.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: UUID of active file to recycle

put.summary:
Updates file name, folder assignment, or access level without re-uploading content.
Supports optimistic concurrency via If-Match ETag header. Returns 412 on ETag mismatch; 404 when feature disabled.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: UUID of file to update; route

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional ETag; prevents lost-update race conditions

requestBody.description: Body with optional name, folderId, accessLevel fields

post.summary:
Searches active files for an entity by type, ID, with an optional folder or name keyword filter, and activity date range.
If both folderId and search are supplied, the name keyword is used for retrieval and folderId is ignored.
Returns flat collection; no pagination applied. EntityType and EntityId required.

requestBody.description: Body with entityId + entityType required; folderId and search are optional, and search takes precedence when both are set

post.summary:
Uploads a file as multipart/form-data to an entity. Validates extension and enforces 100 MB size limit.
Requires X-Idempotency-Key header and write scope. Returns 201 with Location header.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required UUID v4; prevents duplicate uploads 24 hours

get.summary: Returns all active folders for an entity. Provide entityId (integer) and entityType (Account, Carrier, or General) as query params. Transparently routes between file management service and legacy WCF backend.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Required positive integer; entity's unique identifier

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Required enum; Account, Carrier, or General

400.description: Bad Request - invalid entity type provided.

403.description: Forbidden - insufficient permissions to access folders.

404.description: Not Found - entity does not exist.

post.summary: Creates a folder for an Account or Carrier entity. Supports optional parent folder nesting via parentFolderId. Requires X-Idempotency-Key header and write scope. Returns 201 with Location header on success.

requestBody.description: Body; entityId, entityType, name required; parentFolderId optional

400.description: Bad Request - missing or invalid required field.

409.description: Conflict - idempotency key already used for an in-flight request.

put.summary:
Renames a folder by its GUID using full replacement semantics. New name must be 1-255 characters and
unique within the parent entity. Feature-flagged; returns 404 when file management is disabled.

parameters.name: folderIdentifier
parameters.description: Folder GUID route param; identifies folder to rename.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type: Account, Carrier, or General.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Entity integer ID owning this folder.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid input or folder name.

404.description: Not Found - folder does not exist or file management is disabled.

409.description: Conflict - folder name already in use.

patch.summary: Archives a folder via JSON Patch replace on /status with value archive. Archived folders reject new file uploads. Optional X-Idempotency-Key header deduplicates retries within a 24-hour window.

parameters.name: folderIdentifier
parameters.description: Folder GUID route param; identifies folder to archive.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type: Account, Carrier, or General.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Entity integer ID owning this folder.

202.description: Accepted - duplicate request; prior response not yet available.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid patch operation or folder cannot be archived.

404.description: Not Found - folder does not exist or file management is disabled.

delete.summary:
Permanently deletes an empty folder. Returns 409 if folder contains files. Requires folderIdentifier GUID
as route param; entityId and entityType as query params for two-factor deletion safety.

parameters.name: folderIdentifier
parameters.description: Folder GUID route param; two-factor deletion confirmation.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Entity integer ID owning this folder.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type: Account, Carrier, or General.

400.description: Bad Request - the request was invalid.

404.description: Not Found - folder does not exist or belongs to another tenant.

409.description: Conflict - folder contains one or more files and cannot be deleted.
